    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})

    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (handle commas)

    # Filter out out_of_range body_mass_g values
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)].dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    avg_mass = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return avg_mass.to_dict()
